response.note: Interpreted 'early September' as Sept 1-10, 2026 and 'performance' as daily attempts, success rate and successful amount for the UPI method family; the 'SUCCESS' status value and 'UPI' method_family value are assumed since the schema does not list them.
response.sql: SELECT txn_date, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN amount_inr ELSE 0 END) AS successful_amount_inr FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-11' AND method_family = 'UPI' GROUP BY txn_date ORDER BY txn_date LIMIT 50
